picks.title: Ten things we have to tell you
items: You are the funniest person we know

timeline.title: A Short History of Best Friends
items: Aristotle wrote that true friendship is one of the most important things in a good life.
A. A. Milne published Winnie the Pooh, and the world met its most famous pair of best friends.
The TV show Friends began, and a group of pals on a sofa became family for millions.
The United Nations made 30 July the International Day of Friendship.
today: Not in the history books yet. But in mine, the best friend anyone has ever had.

letters.title: What the World Has Said About Friendship
items: What! You too? I thought I was the only one.
C. S. Lewis, The Four Loves
A friend is a single soul dwelling in two bodies.
The only way to have a friend is to be one.
Shared joy is a double joy, shared sorrow is half a sorrow.
letters.hand: They all say it beautifully. I just say: thank you for being you, {who}.

facts.title: The Science of Best Friends
items: One researcher found we are around thirty times more likely to laugh with others than alone.
Close friends' brains react in strikingly similar ways when they watch the same videos.
In one study, a hill looked less steep to people standing next to a friend.
One study suggests it takes about 200 hours together to become close friends. Worth every minute.
Most of us have room for only about five very closest friends. You made the cut.
Strong friendships are linked to lower stress and longer, healthier lives.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It still cannot explain how {who} always knows exactly what to say.

world.title: Why the World Is Better With {who} In It
world.lead: Unfiltered and true, because {who} exists, the world got:
items: Someone who says what we are all thinking.
A friend who never, ever judges.
Honesty, even when we did not ask.
world.close: No filter needed, {who}. You are brilliant.

promises.title: My unfiltered promises
items: To always tell you if there is spinach in your teeth.
To never let you text your ex.
To laugh at you, and with you.
To tell you the truth, always.
To be your friend, no matter how late you are.

cert: The Best Friend in the World
perfume: Top notes of late night laughter, shared fries and loyalty. A heart of pure gold.

news.headline: {who} named best friend of the century
news.lead: Sources close to the friendship confirm that {who} has, once again, been there at exactly the right moment with snacks, jokes and a hug.
news.weather: Weather: sunny, with a 100% chance of inside jokes

quiz: Studies say true friends tell each other the truth. How often do people admit to telling friends small white lies?
What does the phrase "warts and all" mean?

note.title: Why we made it unfiltered
paras: Most gifts are full of compliments. This one is full of the truth, because that is what real friends do.
The bad habits, the embarrassing moments and, underneath it all, how much they mean to you.
From everything {from} told us, you are perfect exactly as you are. Mostly.

own.dayTitle: A Day in the Life of {first}, Honestly
day: Snoozed. Alarms two to six, also snoozed.
Still at home. Still looking for keys.
Orders a salad. Eats everyone's chips.
Says "I am not drinking". Is on the table by ten.
night: Twelve minutes long. Mostly laughing. Completely perfect.
guide: Making any situation more embarrassing, and more fun
Very late at night, and very late for everything
Forgive the lateness. Hide the chips. Never stop laughing
little: You always say you are five minutes away. You never are.
You tell strangers your whole life story in a queue.
You still have my jumper from 2015. I want it back.
You are there in a heartbeat, every single time.
